<b>Restoration of Bellhart</b> is a [[Donate Wishes|Donate Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, found on the Wishwall of [[Bellhart]] after upgrading the [[Needle]] once, selling at least one [[Items (Silksong)#Tradables|Relic]] to [[Relic Seeker Scrounge]], speaking with Pavo and returning after benching outside Bellhart. 

== Wish ==
To complete the Wish, donate {{R|250}} to the Bellhart Wishwall. <i>Restoration of Bellhart</i> is a prerequisite Wish required to unlock the <i>[[Bellhart's Glory]]</i> Wish.
